items.title: Content studio
items.summary: Plans, writes and edits a steady stream of articles and posts in one voice, and keeps the calendar honest.
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Data analysis
items.summary: Takes a question about your numbers from a clear plan to clean data to a short report that says how sure it is.
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Engineering review
items.summary: Reviews designs before they are built and code before it ships, plans the tests, and writes up what went wrong when something breaks.
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Launch crew
items.summary: Takes a product or feature from ready to announced: the checklist, the page, the notes and the call on whether it ships.
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Newsletter desk
items.summary: Reads widely for you each week and turns the few things worth knowing into one short, checked issue.
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Personal admin
items.summary: Keeps the paperwork of a life in order: bills and renewals, deadlines, and trips, with nothing paid or booked without you.
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Product discovery
items.summary: Works out what to build next from what customers do, what the numbers say and what the alternatives already offer.
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Research desk
items.summary: Answers hard questions with sources: reads the long documents, checks every claim and says how sure it is.
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Sales pipeline
items.summary: Qualifies leads on evidence, plans the follow-ups and drafts the proposals, with every message held for your approval.
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Support desk
items.summary: Drafts replies to customers, turns problems into bug reports and writes the help articles that stop the same question coming back.
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Analysis plan
items.summary: Turn a business question into the exact numbers that would answer it, before any are computed
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Bill review
items.summary: Go through recurring bills and subscriptions, and flag what changed, what is unused and what renews soon
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Blog post draft
items.summary: Draft an article from an outline or a brief, with one point made well rather than five made thinly
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Bug report triage
items.summary: Turn a customer's description of a problem into a bug report an engineer can reproduce
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Competitor scan
items.summary: Compare a few named alternatives on the points a buyer actually decides on
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Content calendar
items.summary: Plan the next few weeks of content around a few themes, with an owner and a date for each piece
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Data cleaning
items.summary: Profile a dataset, fix what is wrong in a copy, and log every change so the analysis can be trusted
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Deadline tracker
items.summary: Keep one list of dated obligations and say each week what is coming due
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Design review
items.summary: Review a technical design before it is built, for what will break, what it costs to run and what it rules out
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Findings report
items.summary: Write up an analysis with the finding first, the evidence in order of weight, and the limits said plainly
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Follow-up plan
items.summary: Plan the next touches with a prospect or client, each one adding something, drafted and held for approval
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Help article
items.summary: Write a help article that gets someone from their question to done in the fewest steps
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Interview synthesis
items.summary: Turn a set of user interviews into patterns with evidence, not a list of opinions
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Landing page copy
items.summary: Write a landing page that says who it is for, what changes for them, and what to do next
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Launch checklist
items.summary: Check a launch is ready item by item, and name exactly what still blocks it
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Lead qualification
items.summary: Decide whether a lead is worth the team's time, on evidence, before anyone writes to them
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Postmortem
items.summary: Write up an incident without blame, so the same thing is less likely to happen again
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Proposal draft
items.summary: Draft a proposal that restates the client's problem, the approach, the price and what happens next
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Reading notes
items.summary: Reduce a long document to what it decides, what it claims and what it leaves open
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Release notes
items.summary: Turn a list of changes into release notes a user reads in under a minute
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Social post set
items.summary: Cut one finished piece into a small set of social posts, each standing on its own
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Source check
items.summary: Check each load-bearing claim in a draft against a primary source before it goes out
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Support reply
items.summary: Draft a reply to a customer that answers the actual question and says what happens next
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Test plan
items.summary: Plan the tests a change needs, aimed at how it could actually fail rather than at coverage
items.author: Bloks

items.title: Trip planner
items.summary: Plan a trip around fixed points, with options to choose from and nothing booked
items.author: Bloks
